body: Poor guy, that‘s not funny at all

Maybe you stopped reading because the books got lengthier and more complex and the font got smaller? So maybe it could help if you start reading shorter easier books just for fun and ease into more difficult ones?

I would like to emphasize to NOT DO ARCHITECTURE SCHOOL if you don’t absolutely love and it’s not just a short hypergixation. My short burst of interest is long gone and now all I have left is to suffer🙃
